Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner continued to instruct the WebSurfer to search based on incorrect assumptions about the forum's name. Instead of "Gorbachev's World Meeting," the forum Gorbachev started was called the "State of the World Forum." The error was due to misidentifying the specific name of the forum, leading the WebSurfer to perform searches with inaccurate keywords, prolonging the task and missing clear identification of the correct forum title. The Planner needed to synthesize the initial data from the search results that indicated the forum name accurately and not continue querying for incorrect terms.
